d: This year's Macy's Thanksgiving parade has been postponed to Saturday due to bad weather. A severe storm is approaching New York City, forcing parade organisers to postpone the event for the first time ever. This year, the parade is expected to have 100 balloons, with just the Helium costing $1.7 Million. The 100 balloons are meant to celebrate 100 years of the Macy's Thanksgiving parade. However, with the parade postponed, many New Yorkers are wondering if Thanksgiving is Cancelled. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
